intro: Thai culture is famous for its temples, food, festivals and a relaxed attitude called sanuk: life should be fun.

chapters.title: Temples and arts
text: Thailand has over 40,000 Buddhist temples, called wats. Classical dance, the Ramakien epic (Thailand's version of the Ramayana) and Thai boxing are all part of its heritage.

chapters.title: Food
text: Thai food balances sweet, sour, salty and spicy. Tom yum soup, green curry, pad thai and som tam (papaya salad) are known worldwide, and street food is everywhere.

chapters.title: Pop culture
text: Thai TV dramas and 'boys' love' series have big audiences across Asia, and Lisa of BLACKPINK is from Thailand.

keyTerms.meaning: The Thai idea that life should be enjoyable.
